verdictReason: All three critique1 findings are resolved in the revised requirements, specification, architect contract/research and associated Draft story. resolvedIssues.resolution: Under test→schedule→occurrence locking, lifecycle interruption atomically settles deferred identity with explicit SKIPPED/SCHEDULE_PAUSED|UPDATED|REMOVED or specific REFUSED invalidation code; no orphan or revival on Resume. Capability disable preserves original grace/cursor and truthful suspended/expired presentation; reenable processes existing identity first, expires without send then advances future-only, or accepts same still-eligible identity once. Feature-off authoring hooks remain effective.

Local minimum is fixed 60 seconds from zero-second minute grammar. Grace is independently configurable with 300-second default. A higher minimum requires a separate validated future policy; no unsupported configurable-minimum property is promised.
